attributes.name: Muminofrah's Favor
attributes.powers:
Display this card next to the scenario. While displayed, any character may recharge a card to add 1d12 to his Diplomacy check.

If the scenario's adventure deck number is 4 or higher, any character may remove this card from the game to draw a random ally that has that adventure deck number from the box.
